jobs.subject: One cream-colored pet ferret, natural standing three-quarter side view facing left. Long slender horizontal torso, rounded ears, short muzzle, four short legs with four separate paws resting on the same ground line, one long tapered tail curving behind. Head upright, back gently arched, no twisted spine.

Exactly two small rabbits seated side by side, a gray-and-white rabbit on the left and a cream rabbit on the right. Each has one head connected to one compact body, two long upright ears, two front paws and two folded hind feet, small round tail. Both upright, looking forward. Separate silhouettes with a narrow white gap, no fused limbs.

One calico kitten FACE ONLY, round cream head, two triangular ears, gray patch over left ear and orange patch over right ear, two eyes, tiny pink nose, symmetric whiskers, warm small smile. No neck or body, no paws.

One brown-and-white spaniel puppy seated naturally facing forward. One round head, two long floppy ears, white blaze and muzzle, brown side patches, white chest. Two straight front legs ending in two paws below the chest, two folded hind haunches with feet at the sides. One small tail. Balanced upright seated pose.

One blue-gray short-haired kitten seated upright in three-quarter view facing left. One head, two triangular ears, pale muzzle and chest. Two front legs straight down ending in paired front paws, two folded hind legs, one tail curling along the ground beside the body. Rounded feline torso with a clear shoulder and hip, no twisted joints.

One gray-and-cream guinea pig in a natural low crouched three-quarter side view facing right. Compact horizontal oval torso, small rounded ears, blunt muzzle, two eyes, four very short legs with four small feet underneath the body. No visible tail, no rabbit ears, no human hands.

One cream-and-apricot hamster sitting upright naturally, front view. One small round head connected to a compact pear-shaped body, two small ROUND ears, two tiny front paws held at chest level, two hind feet supporting the body below, tiny tail hidden. Full body, no extra fingers, no elongated ears.

One silver long-haired kitten seated naturally, front three-quarter view. Two pointed ears, round feline face, cream muzzle, green eyes, fluffy gray torso. Two front paws below chest, folded hind feet at sides, one bushy tail curved upward behind its right side. All body parts connected clearly.

One small apricot curly-haired poodle puppy standing on all four paws in three-quarter view facing left. One head, two floppy ears, short muzzle, compact horizontal torso, four distinct legs under the body, one little tail behind. Lightly indicated soft curls, closed readable contour, no furry detached speckles.

One soft gray chinchilla sitting upright in three-quarter view facing right. Two large ROUND ears, rounded short muzzle, one head and compact body, two small forepaws held at belly, two larger hind feet supporting it below, one bushy tail curling behind. A recognizable chinchilla, no rabbit ears or dog muzzle.

One orange-and-white corgi puppy seated naturally in three-quarter view facing right. One head, two triangular upright ears, short canine muzzle, white face blaze and chest, compact torso. Two front legs with paired paws, two folded hind legs with feet at sides, one short tail. Warm happy face, mouth closed.

One small olive-green pet turtle walking naturally, three-quarter view from slightly above, head pointing right. One oval domed shell with clear scute pattern, one small head extending from front opening, four short legs emerging from four appropriate shell corners with four little feet, one short tapered tail behind. No mammal ears, no fused legs, no detached shell.

One cream puppy with warm brown patches seated naturally facing left in three-quarter view. One head with two floppy ears, short canine muzzle, compact torso, two front paws beneath chest, two folded hind feet beside rump, one tail curled behind. One eye can be partly obscured by perspective, not an extra eye.

One small white bichon puppy sitting upright facing forward. Round fluffy head, two soft floppy ears, black eyes and tiny black nose, pale cream chest. Two front legs with two paws directly below chest, two folded hind feet to the sides, one small tail behind. Light curly outline but clean continuous edges, full body.

One golden retriever puppy HEAD ONLY facing forward, round head, two symmetrical floppy ears, two small dark eyes, one tiny brown nose and short rounded canine muzzle, warm calm expression. No body, no paws, no extra shapes.

One ginger tabby cat curled naturally asleep, three-quarter side view. One head with two triangular ears resting on two tucked front paws, one round curved torso, folded hind legs tucked into the curl, ONE striped tail wrapping along the outside of the body. Closed eyes, clear head-to-neck connection. Compact sleeping cat, not a spiral or turtle.
